top_statements.statement: INSERT INTO flow_steps (run_id, parent_step_id, org_id, node_key, node_type, service, operation, status, attempt, request_id, trace_id, job_id, workflow_id, queue_name, provider, metadata) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'running', $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14, $15) RETURNING id
UPDATE flow_steps SET status = $1, error_code = $2, retryable = $3, finished_at = now(), duration_ms = round(extract(epoch from (now() - started_at)) * 1000) WHERE id = $4

SELECT u.email, u.name, u."emailVerified" AS email_verified, iu.suspended_at FROM "session" s JOIN "user" u ON u.id = s."userId" LEFT JOIN users iu ON iu.auth_user_id = u.id WHERE s.id = $1 AND u.id = $2 AND s."expiresAt" > now()
SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower($1) AND (auth_user_id IS NULL OR auth_user_id <> $2) LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO users (auth_user_id, email, display_name, avatar_url) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (auth_user_id) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url, updated_at = now() WHERE users.email IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.email OR users.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.display_name OR users.avatar_url IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.avatar_url RETURNING id, auth_user_id, email, display_name, installation_owner, suspended_at
SELECT id, auth_user_id, email, display_name, installation_owner, suspended_at FROM users WHERE auth_user_id = $1 LIMIT 1
UPDATE users SET installation_owner = TRUE, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE installation_owner)
INSERT INTO organizations (name, slug, is_shared) SELECT $1, $2, TRUE WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organizations WHERE is_shared) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) SELECT o.id, $1, 'admin' FROM organizations o JOIN users u ON u.id = $1 WHERE o.is_shared AND u.installation_owner ON CONFLICT (org_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = 'admin', updated_at = now() WHERE org_members.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin'
INSERT INTO usage_reconciliation_state (org_id) SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE is_shared ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO NOTHING
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.slug, om.role FROM org_members om JOIN organizations o ON o.id = om.org_id WHERE om.user_id = $1 AND o.is_shared AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR o.id = $2) LIMIT 1
SELECT installation_owner FROM users WHERE id = $1

SELECT u.email, u.name, u."emailVerified" AS email_verified, iu.suspended_at FROM "session" s JOIN "user" u ON u.id = s."userId" LEFT JOIN users iu ON iu.auth_user_id = u.id WHERE s.id = $1 AND u.id = $2 AND s."expiresAt" > now()
SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower($1) AND (auth_user_id IS NULL OR auth_user_id <> $2) LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO users (auth_user_id, email, display_name, avatar_url) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (auth_user_id) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url, updated_at = now() WHERE users.email IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.email OR users.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.display_name OR users.avatar_url IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.avatar_url RETURNING id, auth_user_id, email, display_name, installation_owner, suspended_at
SELECT id, auth_user_id, email, display_name, installation_owner, suspended_at FROM users WHERE auth_user_id = $1 LIMIT 1
UPDATE users SET installation_owner = TRUE, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE installation_owner)
INSERT INTO organizations (name, slug, is_shared) SELECT $1, $2, TRUE WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organizations WHERE is_shared) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) SELECT o.id, $1, 'admin' FROM organizations o JOIN users u ON u.id = $1 WHERE o.is_shared AND u.installation_owner ON CONFLICT (org_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = 'admin', updated_at = now() WHERE org_members.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin'
INSERT INTO usage_reconciliation_state (org_id) SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE is_shared ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO NOTHING
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.slug, om.role FROM org_members om JOIN organizations o ON o.id = om.org_id WHERE om.user_id = $1 AND o.is_shared AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR o.id = $2) LIMIT 1
SELECT installation_owner FROM users WHERE id = $1
